subject: Fix discarded-qualifiers warnings reported by fedorarawhide (#2874)
reason: The change only adds const qualifiers to local pointer declarations (char * -> const char *) in cli_common.c, module.c, networking.c and resp_parser.c to silence -Wdiscarded-qualifiers warnings from fedorarawhide builds. No expression, control flow, or data layout changes; the compiled behavior is identical, so no runtime behavior can differ and no scenario is needed.
